worlds.name: Azhen
worlds.description: Opened, measured, and abandoned. Azhimet's people built the gates and left their instruments running.

zones.name: Serrivet
zones.description: The instrument yards, open to the sky and still turning.

zones.name: The Camp
zones.description: Nine years of survey tents pitched inside somebody else's hall.

zones.name: Thessivar
zones.description: The great instrument, built to watch the Unlit, and never switched off.

zones.name: Ummath
zones.description: The near halls. Enormous, precise, and built for a purpose you can almost work out.

rooms.title: The Alignment Marks
rooms.description:
A grid of bronze studs set into the paving, thousands of them, each stamped with a figure. The survey has copied out four hundred and made no progress.

The figures increase towards the edge of the Reach.

rooms.title: The Approach
rooms.description:
A processional way a hundred feet wide, walled on both sides, running towards a building that gets no closer for an uncomfortably long time.

The walls carry the same figure over and over, at head height, all the way along.

rooms.title: The Broken Mount
rooms.description:
The one instrument in Serrivet that has failed: collapsed on its mounting, glass out, arms in the dust.

Everything else in the yard has adjusted to point past it.

rooms.title: The Cable Run
rooms.description:
Bronze cable in stone channels crosses the yard here in bundles, going from the instruments towards the far end, all of it taut and faintly humming.

Whatever is at the far end is still being told.

rooms.title: The Counting House
rooms.description:
A low building at the yard's edge, full of racks of reading plates, each rack labelled with a date.

The dates run out. The plates do not - the last rack is full of blanks with nothing on them at all.

rooms.title: The Drag Line
rooms.description:
Two grooves worn into the paving, a cart-width apart, running dead straight towards the far end of the yard.

They are inches deep. This was not done once.

rooms.title: The First Ring
rooms.description:
An instrument like a well-head twenty feet across, a bronze ring in a stone collar, rotating at about a degree an hour.

Something inside the collar is taking a reading and there is nowhere for it to write it down.

rooms.title: The Instrument Door
rooms.description:
The door of Thessivar: two bronze leaves, sixty feet high, standing a foot apart with cold air coming out between them.

They were not left open. They were stopped while closing.

rooms.title: The Mirror Walk
rooms.description:
A colonnade of polished bronze plates on posts, each angled to throw light down the line to the next.

The light coming along the line is not the colour of the light falling on the yard.

rooms.title: The Quadrant
rooms.description:
A quarter-circle of bronze forty feet tall, graduated the whole way, with a sighting arm halfway up and a ladder to it.

The arm is at the top of its range and has been for a very long time.

rooms.title: The Rim Platform
rooms.description:
A viewing platform out to the side of the approach, railed in bronze, with a mounted glass on a swivel aimed out past the edge of the Reach.

The survey does not use it. Vane used it once.

The instruments here were built to look, and they still are. What they show is not what the eye shows, and the discrepancy is somewhere in the difference between the two.

rooms.title: The Second Yard
rooms.description:
A second paved expanse, emptier, with the mountings stripped and carried off. Only the bolt patterns remain.

Whatever stood here was taken to Thessivar. The drag marks say so.

rooms.title: The Shadow Court
rooms.description:
A sunken square where the paving is marked with radiating lines and a gnomon stands at the middle.

The shadow is on a line. It is not the line the sun would put it on.

rooms.title: The Sighting Line
rooms.description:
A cut runs dead straight between the marks above and the court below, floored with the same crushed rock and kept clear of it. Nothing grows in the channel.

Bronze studs are set into the rock along the centre at intervals. Counting them tells you the spacing is not regular; it changes by the same amount each time.

Whatever this was sighted along is not above you now.

rooms.title: The Tension House
rooms.description:
A shed of screws and springs where the cable tension is kept, with a dial for every line and every dial in its band.

Somebody adjusted these. There is no wear on the handles.

rooms.title: The Yard Gate
rooms.description:
Out of Ummath and into open air, on a paved yard so large the far side is a suggestion. Instruments stand on it in rows.

All of them are turning. Slowly, and together.

The instruments here were built to look, and they still are. What they show is not what the eye shows, and the discrepancy is somewhere in the difference between the two.

rooms.title: The Catalogue Tent
rooms.description:
Trestle tables under canvas, covered in cogs, plates, glass and bone, each with a paper tag. Nine years of finds, catalogued and understood at about one item in forty.

The unread pile is the big one and it is at the back where visitors do not see it.

rooms.title: The Gate Hall
rooms.description:
The ring stands at one end of a hall eighty feet high, cut square, with the walls dressed so flat they take a shine. It is not a room built around a gate. It is a room the gate was fitted into.

Yrriska's shrine is a scratch on the floor and a handful of coins. Nobody has had the nerve to build anything bigger in here.

The way through is up. The hall is eighty feet of dressed stone and the ring sits at the foot of it, which is either the wrong way round or exactly right, depending on what the builders knew that nobody here does.

rooms.title: The Measured Stair
rooms.description:
A stair of forty steps, every step identical to within nothing anyone can measure, going down into the near halls.

The survey has counted the steps eleven times. It has got forty every time and somebody still checks.

rooms.title: The Plate Bench
rooms.description:
A bench under the best lamp in the camp, where Vane works on the reading plates one at a time with a brush and a great deal of patience.

There is a rack of plates behind him that he has stopped putting on the bench.

rooms.title: The Sorting Ground
rooms.description:
Trestle tables under an awning, most of them bare, set far enough apart for a barrow to get between. What comes up out of the deep is opened here before anyone decides what it is.

The tables are numbered in chalk and the numbers run to fourteen. There are six tables.

A crate by the awning post is labelled DO NOT CATALOGUE. Whoever made the joke is long gone, and somebody has been keeping the crate filled.

rooms.title: The Spoil Heap
rooms.description:
Where nine years of unwanted finds have been tipped: broken glass, bent bronze, and stone chipped off things to see what was underneath.

Somebody has started sorting it. Somebody stopped.

rooms.title: The Tent Line
rooms.description:
Nine years of survey camp pitched down the middle of the hall: canvas, cots, a stove with a flue going up into a space that swallows the smoke entirely.

The tents are laid out on the floor's own grid. Everyone did it without discussing it.

rooms.title: The Threshold
rooms.description:
The camp's boundary, marked with a line of lamps and a painted stripe. Past it the survey works in pairs and signs out.

The rule is written on a board and it is not a suggestion.

rooms.title: The Trader's Tent
rooms.description:
One tent, a folding table, and a set of scales that are the most valuable object in Azhen. Sask buys.

What he has for sale is what previous crews sold him, and it is mostly Azhen's own.

rooms.title: The Ascent
rooms.description:
A spiral stair inside the instrument's column, wide enough for two, with a bronze rail worn to a shine on the inside edge.

It is worn on the way up and the way down equally.

rooms.title: The Cable Heads
rooms.description:
Where every cable from Serrivet arrives, forty of them, each terminating in a bronze head that twitches.

They are not delivering power. They are delivering readings, and something is receiving them.

rooms.title: The Counterweight Well
rooms.description:
A shaft beside the stair with the instrument's counterweight in it, a bronze cylinder the size of a cottage, hanging on cable as thick as a leg.

It is at the bottom of its travel. Something has been winding it back up.

rooms.title: The Drum Floor
rooms.description:
A circular floor two hundred feet across under a dome, with the whole floor turning at a rate you feel through your boots rather than see.

The walls are stationary. Walking a straight line takes attention.

rooms.title: The Entry Court
rooms.description:
Inside the doors, a court with a floor of black glass and a ceiling lost above the lamplight. Your footsteps come back a long time later.

The lamps are Azhen's own and they are lit.

rooms.title: The Housing
rooms.description:
The instrument itself: a bronze housing thirty feet across at the top of the column, with the great lens in it, and the lens is aimed out past the edge of the Reach.

It is tracking. It has been tracking one thing for four hundred years and it has never once had to search for it again.

Through the eyepiece the outside is not distance and not dark. It is a surface, and it is much closer than the eye insists, and the reason the instrument has never lost its subject is that its subject has never moved.

rooms.title: The Instrument Corridor
rooms.description:
A corridor wide enough for four abreast, running between the store and the room past it. The floor is clean in a strip down the middle and dusty at both edges.

Machines sit recessed behind glass at eye height the whole length of both walls. Most are dark. Two are not, and the two that are not are keeping different time from one another.

The clean strip is not from feet.

rooms.title: The Lower Gearing
rooms.description:
Under the drum floor, in among the gearing: bronze wheels the height of a house meshing slowly and exactly, in oil, in the dark.

There is a walkway. It was built for people who worked down here while it ran.

rooms.title: The Observation Floor
rooms.description:
The floor the whole building exists to hold up: a ring of eyepieces around a central housing, each with a seat, each seat placed for a person.

All but one of the seats is empty.

rooms.title: The Oil Gallery
rooms.description:
A gallery of reservoirs and drip-feeds keeping the gearing wet, every level in its band, every band marked.

Somebody tops these up.

rooms.title: The Plate Store
rooms.description:
Racks of reading plates, filed by date, running back further than Grask has existed.

The last hundred have all been scraped. The scrapings are in a bowl on the bench.

rooms.title: The Registry
rooms.description:
A desk, a lamp, and the day-book of the observation floor, open, with a pen laid across the page.

Entries every day for four hundred years and then one line that is not a reading.

rooms.title: The Robing Room
rooms.description:
Pegs, benches, and forty bronze mantles hung up in size order. Every peg is full.

Nobody left this building.

rooms.title: The Silent Room
rooms.description:
A chamber off the cable heads, cut square, lined with gate-stone on all six faces. It takes sound and does not give it back.

Speaking in here is like speaking into a coat. It is also the only room in Azhen with no instrument in it, which for these people is a statement.

The way through is up. In a room that takes sound and gives nothing back, it is the only direction anything in here goes.

exits.refusalMessage: Six faces of gate-stone and none of them opens. The room takes the sound of you asking and does not pass it on.

rooms.title: The Blank Gallery
rooms.description:
A gallery as long as both rooms it joins, lined with shallow alcoves at even spacing. Every alcove is empty, and every one has been swept.

Each is labelled along its lower lip in the script used throughout Ummath. The labels are all the same word.

The grinding carries through the far wall, slower here than it sounds from the room itself. That is a property of the wall.

rooms.title: The Cog Gallery
rooms.description:
Racks from floor to ceiling, every rack holding cogs by size, every size labelled. Half the racks are empty and the labels are still there.

Somebody took the small ones first, which is what a thief does and not what a mover does.

rooms.title: The Counterweight Shaft
rooms.description:
A shaft going up out of sight with a bronze block the size of a cart hanging in it, creeping downward at a speed you can just about believe you are imagining.

It has a long way to go. It has had a long way to go for a long time.

rooms.title: The Cross Hall
rooms.description:
Where four halls meet under a dome, with a disc of polished floor at the centre marked with a figure nobody has matched to anything.

Every route in Ummath passes through here. Everything that walks a route arrives here eventually.

rooms.title: The Empty Library
rooms.description:
Shelves cut into the rock, forty feet of them, and not one book, scroll or plate. The shelves are dusted.

Nothing has been burned. Nothing has been dropped. It was emptied.

rooms.title: The First Hall
rooms.description:
A hall the size of a village, floored in a grid of squares each exactly a pace across. The ceiling is out of the lamplight.

Things move at the edges, at a walking pace, on routes.

rooms.title: The Glass Store
rooms.description:
Crates of lens blanks in straw, stacked six high, most of them never opened. The straw is intact. The straw is a hundred years old and it is intact.

One crate has been opened recently and carefully.

rooms.title: The Grinding Room
rooms.description:
Six grinding frames, all running, all working glass that is no longer there. The arms go round and the wheels turn and the tolerance is still being held.

It is the loudest room in Ummath and there is nothing in it.

rooms.title: The Long Gallery
rooms.description:
Four hundred feet of gallery with alcoves down both sides, each alcove holding a mounting, each mounting empty.

The mountings are all aimed the same way, and it is not at anything in this room.

rooms.title: The Outer Door
rooms.description:
A doorway forty feet high standing open on daylight and dust. The instrument yards are past it and the noise of them is already here.

The door itself lies flat on the floor inside, where it was taken down and laid out neatly.

rooms.title: The Pump Room
rooms.description:
A room of bronze cylinders and rocking beams, working, in oil, with no attendant and no obvious source of power.

The oil is clean.

rooms.title: The Standing Rail
rooms.description:
A rail of bronze runs down the middle of the hall at waist height, polished bright on the top surface for its whole length.

Things have been sliding along it. Recently. All of them going the same way.

rooms.title: The Sweeper Run
rooms.description:
A side gallery with a shallow channel cut down the middle of the floor, worn a finger deep by things going up and down it.

They are still going up and down it.

rooms.title: The Warden Post
rooms.description:
An alcove with a bronze figure in it, human-shaped, holding a door that is not there any more.

It has been holding the doorway for longer than the door lasted.

rooms.title: The Water Stair
rooms.description:
A stair with a channel running down beside it carrying clear water, fast and quiet, from somewhere above to somewhere below.

It has not silted. Something is keeping it clear.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of measurer's gloves
itemTemplates.description: Fine work, with the fingertips left bare and a scale printed down the back of each hand.

itemTemplates.name: a counterweight maul
itemTemplates.description: A housing counterweight on a shaft. It was never a weapon and it is a very good one.

itemTemplates.name: a drive cog
itemTemplates.description: Bronze, hand-sized, with teeth cut to a tolerance nobody in the Reaches can match now.

itemTemplates.name: a gate stylus
itemTemplates.description: A hand-length spike of gate-stone in a bronze grip, for cutting marks into things that do not take marks.

itemTemplates.name: a lens blank
itemTemplates.description: Uncut glass, still in its shipping straw, ground on one face only. There are crates of them and no one to finish them.

itemTemplates.name: a lens hood
itemTemplates.description: Bronze, fitted to the head, with smoked glass on a hinge. It was made for looking at something too bright and works on blows as well.

itemTemplates.name: a measuring rod
itemTemplates.description: Bronze, a shade over five feet, graduated the whole way. Azhen made everything to be measured and some of it to be hit.

itemTemplates.name: an orrery guard
itemTemplates.description: A hinged bronze fan, part of a housing, taken off something and strapped to an arm by somebody in a hurry.

itemTemplates.name: a plated skirt
itemTemplates.description: Bronze strips on a belt, cut to let a person kneel at an instrument all day.

itemTemplates.name: a reading stone
itemTemplates.description: A disc of clear glass on a chain, ground so true it has no distortion at all. Looking through it is exactly like not.

itemTemplates.name: a scaled mantle
itemTemplates.description: Overlapping bronze scales on a linen backing, each scale numbered. The numbering does not run in order.

itemTemplates.name: a silenced plate
itemTemplates.description: A reading plate with its entry scraped off. The scraping was done carefully, and it was done from the inside of the housing.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of shod sandals
itemTemplates.description: Bronze soles over cork. They ring on a floor and every floor in Azhen was made to be rung on.

itemTemplates.name: a roll of clean bandage
itemTemplates.description: Boiled linen, rolled tight, tied with a scrap of the same. Sold by the roll because nobody needs half of one.

itemTemplates.name: a tempered stormrod
itemTemplates.description: Bronze wound with wire that stands the hair up on your arm when the weather turns. Folded again with something out of Grask in it, and heavier for the knowing.

itemTemplates.name: a measured stormrod
itemTemplates.description: Bronze wound with wire that stands the hair up on your arm when the weather turns. Trued against an Azhen rule. Every measurement on it is a measurement of something else.

itemTemplates.name: a tempered hearthcenser
itemTemplates.description: A censer on a chain, weighted for swinging and never once used for incense. Folded again with something out of Grask in it, and heavier for the knowing.

itemTemplates.name: a measured hearthcenser
itemTemplates.description: A censer on a chain, weighted for swinging and never once used for incense. Trued against an Azhen rule. Every measurement on it is a measurement of something else.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of tempered quiet wraps
itemTemplates.description: They make no sound until they land. Somebody took a great deal of trouble over that. Folded again with something out of Grask in it, and heavier for the knowing.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of measured quiet wraps
itemTemplates.description: They make no sound until they land. Somebody took a great deal of trouble over that. Trued against an Azhen rule. Every measurement on it is a measurement of something else.

itemTemplates.name: a tempered oathmaul
itemTemplates.description: Head like a milestone, haft the length of a person. It was made to stop something. Folded again with something out of Grask in it, and heavier for the knowing.

itemTemplates.name: a measured oathmaul
itemTemplates.description: Head like a milestone, haft the length of a person. It was made to stop something. Trued against an Azhen rule. Every measurement on it is a measurement of something else.

itemTemplates.name: a coil of hemp rope
itemTemplates.description: Twenty feet, laid three-strand, with the ends whipped properly. Whoever made this was not in a hurry.

itemTemplates.name: a pitch torch
itemTemplates.description: A hand's length of ash wrapped in pitch-soaked rag. Takes a hand to carry and smells like it the whole time.

mobTemplates.name: Ordrel Sask, trader
mobTemplates.description: One tent, thin stock, and a buying book far fatter than a selling one. He is here for what comes out, not for what goes in.

emotes.text: says, 'Bring me cogs. I will buy every cog you find and I will not ask.'
writes a weight into the buying book and underlines it

greeting: 'Bring me cogs. I will buy every cog you find and I will not ask. Ask me about the <book> if you want to know why.'

topics.text: 'Buying book, not selling. Nine years of it. Everything that comes out of the halls goes in with a weight beside it, and the weights add up to a number I send back through the gate every month, to people who do not tell me what they want it for. That is the whole trade in Azhen.'

mobTemplates.name: an engine
mobTemplates.description: Built to move counterweights and to hold them absolutely still. Slow, direct, and it does not know what it is pushing.

mobTemplates.name: a brass flitter
mobTemplates.description: A hand-sized maintenance thing on four wings, still doing its round of a room nobody is in.

mobTemplates.name: Bellic Vane, who reads the plates
mobTemplates.description: The only person alive who can work an Azhen instrument, and painfully aware that this is a low bar and that he set it.

emotes.text: turns a plate to the light and holds it there
says, 'It is still taking readings. That is not the strange part.'

greeting: 'It is still taking readings. That is not the strange part. Ask about the <readings> if you want the strange part.'

topics.text: 'Four hundred years of plates, one a day, and the last hundred scraped blank from the inside. Not lost. Removed. People do not carefully destroy a thing they think is wrong.'

'Everyone says attention, as though the dark were looking at us. The instrument does not agree. It has held one position for four centuries and never once had to search. That is not attention. Attention wanders.'

'One seat on the observation floor, occupied since the last reading. I did not look through the eyepiece on the way past. I asked you not to, and I did not myself. I have the blank. I do not need to see the thing it describes.'

mobTemplates.name: a kept scholar
mobTemplates.description: A scholar of Azhimet in a bronze mantle, still at the instrument, still taking the reading. They did not die and they did not leave.

mobTemplates.name: a servitor
mobTemplates.description: A maintenance thing of bronze, knee high or head high depending on its station, still doing its round of a hall nobody is in. It objects to obstructions.

mobTemplates.name: Survey-lead Immeth
mobTemplates.description: She has been cataloguing Azhen for nine years with a crew of four and has stopped expecting to finish.

emotes.text: measures a doorway that has already been measured, and writes it down again
says, 'Everything here was built to a tolerance. Everything. Ask why.'

greeting: 'Nine years,' she says, not looking up. 'I am about a third through. Do not ask me a third of what.'
'If you find a room in Azhen that is not square, come and tell me. It has not happened yet.'
'Everything here was built to a <tolerance>. Everything. Ask why.'

topics.text: 'A cog cut four hundred years ago seats in a housing today with a click. They built as though they expected to be replacing parts this afternoon. Either they were very sure of themselves, or they were very sure of something else.'
'Nine years, four of us, and not one room out of true. Not one. People call it craftsmanship. Craftsmanship has an off day. This never did.'
'They had a unit. It is not ours and it is not any settler's, and it is cut into every doorframe in Azhen. I have it to four places and I do not know what it is a fraction of.'

'There is a milestone on the road in Nemhal cut in that same unit. I have seen a rubbing. They were there before the Hold, before the cult, before anybody, and they measured the distance to where a god would later lie down. I do not sleep well on that one.'

mobTemplates.name: the Last Reader
mobTemplates.description: The one who took the final reading and then scraped it off the plate. They are still at the eyepiece and they have not looked away.

mobTemplates.name: a warden
mobTemplates.description: Bronze, human-shaped, and posted. It has held this door since Azhimet had clergy.

mobTemplates.name: Vesh, who follows the gates
mobTemplates.description: A smith with a travelling anvil and no forge, who has been at every crossing anyone can remember and looks no older in any of the stories. She works for materials and will not take coin.

emotes.text: turns a piece over and puts it back in the bag unfinished
says, 'I do not sell. Bring me something and I will make it better.'
sets an anvil down that nobody saw her carrying

greeting: 'You have seen me before. You will again. I do not explain that and neither should you.'
'I do not sell. Bring me something that has been through something and I will make it better. Ask about the <embers> if you want to know what I work with.'

topics.text: 'They do not go out and they do not warm anything. I keep a jar. Where the first one came from is a thing I know and a thing you do not need to.'
'Every crossing anyone can remember, and I am at every one of them. I do not go through. I am at. Those are different, and the difference is most of what I know.'

abilities.name: Kick
abilities.description: A boot to the knee. Nothing elegant, and it does not care what you are holding.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: Put your shoulder behind it. Slower, and it lands heavier.

abilities.name: Battle Fury
abilities.description: Anger sharpens the next stretch of a fight.

abilities.name: Sunder
abilities.description: Batter the guard apart. What comes next lands on what is left of it.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: Say something unforgivable about its mother, at volume.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: The flat of the shield, hard, into whatever is nearest to a jaw.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.description: Find your feet again in the middle of it.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Set yourself. Nothing moves you for a while.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.description: One heavy swing, wound up and committed to.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.description: Refuse to fall. The refusal is most of it.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Shield into the ground, once. Everything in the room decides you are the problem.

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.description: Everything behind you is behind you.

abilities.name: Ground and Centre
abilities.description: More of you to get through, and less give in any of it.

abilities.name: Reprisal
abilities.description: Answer it, and make sure it noticed who did.

abilities.name: Unbreakable
abilities.description: Decide not to. The fight can disagree for a while.

abilities.name: Sundering Blow
abilities.description: Take the guard apart so that everyone else's work lands on what is left.

abilities.name: Mass Provocation
abilities.description: Say the unforgivable thing to the whole room, and mean every word of it.

abilities.name: The Last Wall
abilities.description: There is a place past which things do not go. You are standing on it.

abilities.name: Bolt
abilities.description: A thrown splinter of raw force.

abilities.name: Arcane Shield
abilities.description: A shell of ordered air, briefly.

abilities.name: Weaken
abilities.description: Unpick the strength out of something.

abilities.name: Amplify
abilities.description: Wind the next few strikes tighter.

abilities.name: Scorch
abilities.description: Heat with intent behind it, and nowhere for the heat to go.

abilities.name: Enfeeble
abilities.description: Take the fight out of it at the root.

abilities.name: Disjunction
abilities.description: Pull something apart along the seams it did not know it had.

abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.description: Fill the room with fire and let it decide what burns.

abilities.name: Transmutation
abilities.description: Spend the body to feed the mind. It takes a moment, and it is not a trick you have twice.

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.description: The long words. Slow to say, and worth saying.

abilities.name: Conflagration
abilities.description: Set the air going and let it keep going.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.description: Find the fault, and put everything into it.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: It picks its own way across the room and is not slow about it.

abilities.name: Unmaking
abilities.description: Take away some of what it is, and it hits like something less.

abilities.name: Pyre
abilities.description: Everything in the room, twice - once now and once for a while afterwards.

abilities.name: Arcane Surge
abilities.description: The window you fire the long words through.

abilities.name: Gravity Well
abilities.description: Nothing in the room is going anywhere, and standing there is costing it.

abilities.name: The Unwriting
abilities.description: Say what a thing is not, at sufficient volume.

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: In and out before it turns.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.description: Not being where the blow lands.

abilities.name: Fortify
abilities.description: Settle your grip and pick the angle.

abilities.name: Low Kick
abilities.description: Take the leg out from under it. Whatever it was going to do next, it is not going anywhere.

abilities.name: Body Blow
abilities.description: Ribs, and what is behind them. It will be feeling this for a while.

abilities.name: Provoke
abilities.description: A hit where it will be noticed, and a look daring it to do something about it.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: The fight has been going a while. You have more left in you than it has.

abilities.name: Heart Strike
abilities.description: One place, once, properly.

abilities.name: Pressure Point
abilities.description: Find the place that runs the rest of it, and close it.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.description: Something inside it is now outside the arrangement.

abilities.name: Opening
abilities.description: Cheap, fast, and it makes the next one worse for them.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: More than it can count, in less time than it has.

abilities.name: Hemorrhage
abilities.description: Cheap to start and expensive to be on the wrong end of.

abilities.name: Execution
abilities.description: The whole fight, arriving at once and slightly early.

abilities.name: Temple Strike
abilities.description: The heel of the hand, where the skull is thinnest. It forgets what it was doing.

abilities.name: A Hundred Hands
abilities.description: None of them would have done it. All of them will.

abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.description: Take the fight out of it and the rest follows on its own.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.description: Close what is open, on yourself or on someone beside you.

abilities.name: Guidance
abilities.description: Steady a hand that is about to need steadying.

abilities.name: Wither
abilities.description: Set something going that will not stop on its own.

abilities.name: Restore
abilities.description: Put back what the fight has taken so far.

abilities.name: Blessing
abilities.description: Lend the next while a better edge than it earned.

abilities.name: Renewal
abilities.description: Begin again, without stopping.

abilities.name: Sap
abilities.description: Take the strength and do not give it back.

abilities.name: Benediction
abilities.description: Say it over everyone at once, and mean it.

abilities.name: Intercession
abilities.description: Stand between someone and what was coming for them.

abilities.name: Communion
abilities.description: Say it once, for everyone standing with you.

abilities.name: Reproach
abilities.description: A judgement that settles in and stays. It is not shouted; it is simply true.

abilities.name: Fortitude
abilities.description: More of everyone to get through. Set it before you go in.

abilities.name: Staunch
abilities.description: Pressure and a steady hand. No light, no words - just the bleeding stopped.

abilities.name: Aegis
abilities.description: Something between the group and the weather.

abilities.name: Mending Tide
abilities.description: The one that comes in over everyone at once, when Communion was not enough.

abilities.name: The Account
abilities.description: Everything owed, called in at once. You have been keeping it whether you meant to or not.

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.description: Draw the line around all of them at once, and make it hold.

abilities.name: Absolution
abilities.description: Everything, off one person, now.

abilities.name: Consecration
abilities.description: Support that is not mending: the whole group hits like it means it.

abilities.name: The Long Vigil
abilities.description: Close what is open, raise what is left, and stand over all of it.

quests.name: Blanks and Cogs
quests.summary: Bring Vane six lens blanks and six drive cogs.
quests.description: The instrument at Thessivar can be restarted. Vane needs parts, and he needs them from the yards rather than from the camp's catalogue, because the catalogue has none left.

dialogue.giverOffer: Vane has a housing open on the bench. 'It is not broken. Nothing here is broken. It is short of <parts>, because somebody carried them off, and I would like to put some back.'
dialogue.turninReady: He fits one without measuring it and it seats with a click. 'You understand what that means,' he says. 'Made to a tolerance, four hundred years ago, by people who expected to be replacing them today.'
dialogue.giverComplete: 'Six. And do not clean the teeth. I want to see the wear.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Cogs. Bronze, hand-sized, teeth cut better than anything you have ever held. The yards are full of them and so are the things in the yards.'

quests.name: The Scraped Plates
quests.summary: Recover four silenced plates from Thessivar.
quests.description: Every reading plate from the last century of Thessivar has been scraped clean, and the scraping was done from inside the housing. Vane wants the plates anyway.

dialogue.giverOffer: 'Four hundred years of readings,' Vane says, 'and the last hundred are blank. Not missing. <Scraped>. By hand, carefully, from the inside.' He looks up. 'People do not carefully destroy a thing they think is wrong.'
dialogue.turninReady: He works one under the lamp for a long time. 'It is a position,' he says finally. 'Not a brightness, not a distance. A position, and it is the same on all four, and the dates are ninety years apart.' He sets it down. 'It has not moved.'
dialogue.giverComplete: 'Four. Bring me the worst ones. The worst ones are the least well scraped.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Four plates. Scraped ones. I can read a scraping - there is always something left in the cut.'

quests.name: What It Is Watching For
quests.summary: Take the last reading from the Last Reader.
quests.description: The one occupied seat on the observation floor has been occupied for four hundred years. Vane wants what is in the housing, and he has stopped pretending he wants it for the catalogue.

dialogue.giverOffer: 'There is <one seat> taken up there,' Vane says. 'The same one. They took the last reading and then they scraped it off, and then they stayed.' He puts his brush down. 'I would like to know what a person reads and then sits down for four hundred years.'
dialogue.turninReady: Vane holds the blank up and does not need a lamp for it. 'The Regard is not attention,' he says quietly. 'We have all been saying attention. It is recognition. It is not watching the Reaches. It is watching for something, it has been watching for the same something since before Azhen, and it has never once had to look away and find it again.' He sits down. 'Nemhal is closer to the edge than we are. Go and ask them what it looks like from there.'
dialogue.giverComplete: 'They are still sitting there. They will be sitting there tomorrow.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'The housing, at the top. Take the blank from the seat. Do not look through the eyepiece on the way past. I am asking, not instructing.'

quests.name: The Stormrod, measured
quests.description: Vesh works for materials and not for coin, and she has decided what she is making for you before you asked.

dialogue.giverOffer: Vesh holds a hand out without looking up. '<Give it here>. It has been through something and I can do more with it now than I could before.'
dialogue.turninReady: She works without hurrying and hands them back. 'Better,' she says. That is the whole of her opinion and it is worth more than it sounds.
dialogue.giverComplete: 'When it has been through something. Not before.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'The pair I gave you. I am not making a second set - I am making those again, and better.'
